long.title: Which Spider Bite Can Actually Kill You? 12 Snake & Spider Myths
tags: which spider bite can kill you
do you swallow spiders in your sleep
long.comment:
📝 SCORE CHECK: how many did you get out of 12? 👇

Answer key: TRUE = a headless snake can still bite, wolf spiders carry their babies, hognose snakes fake their death, jumping spiders twitch in their sleep. Everything else was FALSE.

Who told you the "8 spiders a year" one? Comment it.
long.description:
Which spider bite can actually kill you? Do you really swallow spiders in your sleep? Can a dead snake still bite? 12 snake and spider myths, 3 seconds each. Keep score and drop it in the comments 👇

0:00 Play along
0:09 You swallow about eight spiders a year in your sleep?
1:02 A snake with no head can still bite you?
1:48 Baby rattlesnakes are more dangerous than adults, because they can't control their venom?
2:39 Wolf spider moms carry their babies on their backs?
3:19 Cottonmouths will chase you?
3:53 A tarantula bite can kill you?
4:29 Snakes unhinge their jaws to swallow big meals?
5:16 A brown recluse bite will rot your flesh away?
6:02 Red touches yellow, kills a fellow. That rhyme works on any coral snake?
6:43 The hognose snake fakes its own death?
7:19 Some spiders twitch in their sleep, like they're dreaming?
7:58 The black widow is the deadliest spider?
8:41 Scores

Subscribe: Saturday it's how cats domesticated themselves.

shorts.title: Do You Really Swallow Spiders in Your Sleep? 🕷️
shorts.description:
TRUE or FALSE? You swallow about eight spiders a year in your sleep. Guess before the timer, then comment if you got it right 👇 

Bonus fact: Common house spiders build messy cobwebs in quiet corners and mostly eat insects that blunder into them.
